definition.def: A particular sector of a country's economy is the part connected with that specified type of industry.
examples: ...the service sector of the Hong Kong economy.

definition.def: A sector of a large group is a smaller group which is part of it.
examples: The poorest sector of the population tends to be disproportionately affected by a recession. [+ of]

definition.def: A sector is an area of a city or country which is controlled by a military force.
examples: Officers were going to retake sectors of the city. [+ of]

definition.def: A sector is a part of a circle which is formed when you draw two straight lines from the centre of the circle to the edge. [technical]
